LanguageData.CC_Settings_Camps: ... including groups who make camp on the map
LanguageData.CC_Settings_Camps_Tip: Now and then a group that isn't hostile (hunters, refugees, prospectors, pilgrims, traders, a smith, a hermit, healers, a procession of the faithful, traveling players, surveyors) makes camp on the colony's map for a few days to a season. They build a small camp, hunt and cut wood around it, and can be traded with, given terms, hired, asked to leave or driven off. At most one camp at a time, never in a colony's first weeks. Off: no new camps (one already here stays until its time is up).
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Facts_DressedCold: They have come dressed for the cold, with {THING}.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Facts_DressedHeat: They have come dressed for the heat, with {THING}.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Facts_PitchCold: For the cold nights they will sleep close round the fire.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Facts_PitchColdWind: For the cold nights they will sleep close round the fire, behind a windbreak.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Facts_PitchWind: For the cold nights they will put up a windbreak behind their beds.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Facts_PitchShade: They have picked a spot among the trees, for the shade.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Facts_Both: They will hunt and cut wood around their camp.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Facts_Wood: They will cut wood around their camp.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Facts_Game: They will hunt around their camp.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Facts_Talk: Once they are settled, the World page has their camp: trade, terms, gifts, hiring, and asking them to move on.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Arrived: The {NAME} from {FACTION} reached their spot {PLACE} and started putting up a camp.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Traded: The colony traded with {X_nameDef} at the camp, and the camp is friendlier for it.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Taken: The camp's {THING} ended up in the colony's stockpile, and the {NAME} noticed.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_FeePaid: The {NAME} paid their fee of {COUNT} silver. It's waiting at the edge of their camp for someone from the colony to fetch.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Shared: The {NAME} left {COUNT} meat at the edge of their camp, the colony's third of their hunt, as agreed.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Tended: {X_nameDef} from the camp tended {A_nameDef}'s wounds where {A_pronoun} lay.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_HelpTitle: A good turn from the camp
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Help_meat: The {NAME} had a good day's hunting, more than they can eat or carry, and left {COUNT} meat at the edge of their camp for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Help_wood: The {NAME} cut more wood than they could burn, and stacked {COUNT} logs on the colony's side of their camp.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Help_medicine: The {NAME} went out gathering healing herbs at dawn, and came back with enough to leave {COUNT} bundles of herbal medicine by their camp for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Help_mend: {X_nameDef} from the camp took one look at the state of {A_nameDef}'s {THING} and mended it on the spot, and wouldn't take anything for the work.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Help_heal: {X_nameDef} from the camp saw to {A_nameDef}'s {THING}, and asked nothing for it. {A_nameDef} is already feeling better.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Help_herbs: The {NAME} had herbs to spare. {COUNT} bundles of herbal medicine are waiting on the colony's side of their camp.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Help_show: The {NAME} put on a show at their fire this evening, and the colony was invited. {X_nameDef} was the star of it.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Help_blessing: {X_nameDef} from the camp came to the colony at dusk and blessed it, its people and its fields, in the old words.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Help_survey: {X_nameDef} from the camp has been taking sightings in the hills, and has shown {A_nameDef} a seam of {THING} in the colony's own rock.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_TensionLabel: Between the colony and the camp
LanguageData.CC_Camp_TensionTip: It grows the longer they stay, the more they take from the land, and when either side breaks the terms. Trade, gifts and friendships ease it. If it breaks, they leave, and their people think less of the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Tension: There were sharp words at the woodpile again today, and a quarrel over whose kill it was. Things are getting tense between the colony and the {NAME} {PLACE}, and some colonists would like the camp gone. The council could set terms, smooth things over with a gift, or ask them to move on.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_TensionHigh: Relations with the {NAME} {PLACE} are close to breaking. {X_nameDef} has stopped returning greetings, and the camp is all the colonists talk about at meals. If nothing changes, the {NAME} will leave on bad terms, and {FACTION} will hear about it.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Took: So far they have felled {0} trees and hunted {1} animals.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Term_FeeAmount: a fee of {0} silver every five days
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Term_Fee_Tip: They pay silver every five days for the use of the land, left where the colony can collect it.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Term_Share_Tip: A third of the meat from every animal they bring in is left for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Term_Boundary_Tip: They cut wood and hunt only on the far side of their camp from the colony, closer in, and less of it each day.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Term_Limit_Tip: They leave within three days. Asking them to go before then breaks the colony's own word.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Term_NotForThem: This group can't agree to that.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Broken_boundary: The {NAME} {PLACE} cut wood on the colony's side of their camp today, against the terms they agreed to.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Broken_share: The {NAME} {PLACE} brought in a kill and kept every scrap of it, though they agreed to share a third.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Broken_fee: The camp {PLACE} sent word that their fee will be late this time, and didn't say why.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Reminded: {X_nameDef} agrees to keep to the terms.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_RemindedStiff: {X_nameDef} agrees to keep to the terms, stiffly. The camp didn't like being told.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_JoinText: {X_nameDef}, from the camp {PLACE}, has been spending evenings with the colonists, and asks whether the colony would take {X_objective} in.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_JoinDeclined: {X_nameDef} nods and goes back to the camp.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Hired: {X_nameDef} from the camp took {COUNT} silver to work for the colony and moved in.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Welcomed: {X_nameDef} said goodbye at the camp's fire and moved in with the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_OverstayTitle: The camp asks for more time
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Overstay: The {NAME} {PLACE} meant to be gone by now, but the camp shows no sign of packing. {X_nameDef} came up to ask whether they could stay a few more days.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Extended: The {NAME} will stay a few days more.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Refused: {X_nameDef} heard the colony out, and said no. They came a long way, {X_pronoun} said. The land isn't the colony's to give, and they'll leave when they're ready.\n\nA gift of {COUNT} silver might change their minds. Insisting will cost goodwill with {FACTION}.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_LetStay: The camp stays, and the matter is dropped.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Force_War: The camp took it as an attack. They are arming themselves, and their people now count the colony as an enemy.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Gifted: The camp accepted the gift of {COUNT} silver.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Opt_AskLeave_Tip: Without a gift, their people take it badly (goodwill falls), and a proud group may refuse.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Opt_AskGift: Ask them to move on, with {COUNT} silver
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Opt_Extend: Let them stay a few more days
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Opt_Force_Tip: Their people will take it as an attack, and goodwill with them falls sharply. If that makes them enemies, the camp will fight. Otherwise they leave right away.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Opt_Force_Confirm: Drive off the camp by force? {0} will take it as an attack on their people.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Deadline: The colony has {0} to answer. If nobody does: "{1}".
LanguageData.CC_Camp_NotTalking: The camp is leaving, or at war with the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Fight: The camp {PLACE} is at war with the colony now. Its people are holding it, and will fight anyone who comes near.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_TurnedBack: The {NAME} from {FACTION} turned back before they made camp.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_time: The {NAME} from {FACTION} packed up their camp {PLACE} and moved on.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_asked: The {NAME} from {FACTION} did as the colony asked. They packed up their camp {PLACE} and moved on.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_forced: Faced with armed colonists, the {NAME} from {FACTION} left their camp {PLACE} in a hurry. Their people will remember it.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_raid: With raiders about, the {NAME} from {FACTION} gathered what they could carry and left their camp {PLACE}. They wanted no part in the colony's fight.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_weather: The weather turned, and the {NAME} from {FACTION} packed up their camp {PLACE} to look for better shelter.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_hunger: The {NAME} from {FACTION} ran out of food. With the hunting poor, they packed up their camp {PLACE} and moved on.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_crowded: The colony has spread out toward the camp {PLACE}. The {NAME} took the hint, packed up and moved on.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_fallout: The {NAME} from {FACTION} had enough of the colony. They broke camp {PLACE} and left without a word to anyone, and their people will hear about it.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_harmed: After the colony turned on them, the {NAME} from {FACTION} fled their camp {PLACE}, leaving most of their things behind.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_arrest: When the colony moved to arrest one of them, the rest of the {NAME} from {FACTION} ran. Their camp {PLACE} stands abandoned, with most of their things still in it.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_fight: The {NAME} from {FACTION} fought the colony at their camp {PLACE}.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_fightOver: The fight at the camp {PLACE} is over. Those of the {NAME} who could still walk have fled, and the camp stands empty.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_lost: The {NAME} from {FACTION} couldn't reach the spot they wanted and moved on.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_empty: The camp {PLACE} stands empty. The last of its people are gone.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Status_Coming: On the way to their spot {1}: {0}.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Status_Living: Camped {1}: {0}. Here for {2}, with about {3} to go.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Status_Overstaying: Camped {1}: {0}. Here for {2}, and past the time they meant to leave.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Status_Fighting: Holding their camp against the colony: {0}.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_TakenSoFar: Taken from the land so far: {0} trees, {1} animals.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Dlg_TradeHow: {X_nameDef} trades from the camp. Select a colonist and right-click {X_objective} to trade.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Dlg_TermsHow: Each term they accept makes things tenser between the two. They may refuse some, and proud groups refuse more.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Dlg_NoHire: Nobody at the camp wants to work for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Dlg_Arrest: To arrest one of them, select a colonist and right-click them, as with any visitor. Their people will take it badly, and the rest of the camp will flee.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_NoneLine: Nobody is camped on our land.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_NoneTip: Camps come on their own time: each morning at ten that one could come (no camp here, a fortnight or so since the last left, no danger on the map, no extreme weather, a friendly people, room on the map, and no question of Rimfolk's waiting for an answer) there is about one chance in twenty that one does. "Rimfolk: check myself" in the mod settings tells the same in more detail.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Why_Open: The way is open: one could come any morning (about one morning in {1}). {0} such morning(s) have passed since the last camp.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Why_off: Camps are switched off in the settings.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Why_nohome: There is no home to camp by.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Why_early: None comes in the first twenty days; {0} to go.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Why_gap: The last left not long ago; the next comes {0} days after at the soonest, in {1}.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Why_threat: None comes while there is danger on the map.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Why_weather: None comes in this weather ({0} °C outside).
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Why_era: No kind of camp fits the colony's era.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Why_nofriends: No friendly people could send one: make peace with a neighbour first.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Why_noroom: There is no room for a camp on the map: open ground some forty cells from the colony, outside the home area and any zone.
